guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 查看 Wick 等候名单
guide.description: 原文要求打开 Wick 等候名单并连接 EVM 钱包，批准连接请求后将钱包加入名单。连接请求不等于代币授权；需核对是否另有签名。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the Wick waitlist and connect your EVM wallet. Approve the connection request, and the page adds your wallet to the list.

guide.title: 了解 Wick 的 X 分享任务
guide.description: 原文称使用个人 X 账号完成分享任务，并关注 Wick 的 X 账号查看上线消息。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Complete the X share task to post about Wick from your account. Follow Wick on X while you’re there, since the team posts its launch news there.

guide.title: 查看 Wick Discord
guide.description: 原文称加入 Wick Discord 可查看公告和提问。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Join the Wick Discord to follow announcements and ask questions.

guide.title: 生成个人邀请链接
guide.description: 原文称在等候名单的邀请（referral）区域输入名字并领取个人邀请链接；只有完成步骤 1 的钱包登记后才开放该选项。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the referral section on the waitlist page, enter a name, and claim your personal referral link. This option only unlocks after your wallet is registered in Step 1.

guide.title: 阅读 Wick 项目文档
guide.description: 原文建议了解 wAMM、wLIT、wLLP 和 sWICK，以理解 Lighter EVM 上的产品。阅读文档不代表需要存款或获得奖励资格。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Read through the Wick docs to learn how wAMM, wLIT, wLLP, and sWICK work. Knowing the products in advance helps you act quickly once deposits open on Lighter EVM.

sourcedSteps.title: Join the Wick Waitlist
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Wick waitlist and connect your EVM wallet. Approve the connection request, and the page adds your wallet to the list.

sourcedSteps.title: Share Wick on X
sourcedSteps.body: Complete the X share task to post about Wick from your account. Follow Wick on X while you’re there, since the team posts its launch news there.

sourcedSteps.title: Join the Wick Discord
sourcedSteps.body: Join the Wick Discord to follow announcements and ask questions.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Your Referral Link
sourcedSteps.body: Open the referral section on the waitlist page, enter a name, and claim your personal referral link. This option only unlocks after your wallet is registered in Step 1.

sourcedSteps.title: Explore the Wick Docs
sourcedSteps.body: Read through the Wick docs to learn how wAMM, wLIT, wLLP, and sWICK work. Knowing the products in advance helps you act quickly once deposits open on Lighter EVM.
